user.title: Select one connected Eteria
user.description: Use a loaded Vitesy Web entry and the exact device name reported by Vitesy. Adding this probe does not connect to the broker or change device settings.

error.invalid_probe_target: Enter a valid entry ID and printable device name.
error.source_entry_not_loaded: The selected Vitesy Web entry is not loaded.
error.source_inventory_unavailable: The selected entry has no usable device inventory.
error.target_device_not_unique: No unique device matches that name in the entry's inventory.
error.target_device_identity_mismatch: The selected device is not a supported Eteria running firmware 1.1.11.
error.target_not_in_running_mqtt_session: The selected Eteria is absent from the current MQTT session.
error.source_mqtt_not_connected: The selected entry does not have a connected MQTT session.
error.source_mqtt_client_mismatch: The selected entry does not have the expected MQTT client.
error.source_mqtt_tls_context_mismatch: The current MQTT client does not expose the expected verified TLS context.
error.unsupported_source_coordinator: The selected entry does not have the expected Vitesy Web coordinator.
error.unsupported_paho_version: The probe requires the existing Paho MQTT 2.1.0 client.
